theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The only theme that is simultaneously rank-1, eligible, trend-gate-passing, high-durability (0.71), and broad (0.93). The trend-gate leg is the one validated risk-control edge, and this theme passes it. Crowding (z=1.19) is a size-down caution, not a fade signal. The call is a conditional lean on continuing trend-eligibility, NOT a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.19 and one-narrative dominance mean the theme is late-stage; attention spikes and ETF inflows historically mark tops, and rank-IC is ~0 so the momentum rank itself carries no forward alpha.
